mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.bill_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.type = 'INCOME' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.type = 'EXPENSE' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM t_bill b WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(b.bill_date, '%Y-%m') BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(b.bill_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT AS categoryId, COALESCE(c.name, '未分类') AS categoryName, COALESCE(c.icon, 'other') AS icon, COALESCE(c.color, '#8C8C8C') AS color, COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_bill b LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.type = #{type} AND b.bill_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY , c.name, c.icon, c.color ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.type = 'INCOME' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.type = 'EXPENSE' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_bill b WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.bill_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
